record.product: New renewable generation projects — prohibition of mandatory storage allocation as precondition
record.status_detail: Mandatory energy-storage allocation must not be made a precondition for the approval, grid connection or feed-in of new renewable projects; renewable generation output in principle enters the power market in full and is priced through trading
record.note: This row extracts only the clauses directly related to grid connection; the price mechanism itself (stock/increment settlement mechanisms) is deferred to a later batch.
